summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 added after ERASE_IN_LINE; ControlCode union gains Tuple[ControlType, str]); rich/control.py (formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title classmethod with docstring, built as one two-item tuple); rich/console.py (set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated on is_terminal, buffers Control.title through self.control, with the required docstring); rich/_windows_renderer.py (new legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title) using the second item); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200); tests added in tests/test_console.py (test_set_window_title, skips on legacy_windows), tests/test_control.py (test_control_title), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title, Windows-only, asserts set_title called once with "Hello, world!"). Not run: tests, mypy, and Black were not executed per instructions, so the changes are verified by reading only. Nothing committed.
